description.zh: 零依赖示例政体：一个最小的、明显是示例的假想政体，用于演示 topology.json 校验、图指标和基线对照的完整链路，不需要任何模型后端。
description.en: Zero-dependency example regime: a minimal, obviously-fictitious governance system used to demonstrate the topology validation, graph metrics, and baseline control pipeline end-to-end without any model backend.

_note: This regime lives under examples/, NOT regimes/, so it is excluded from the 57-regime corpus and from validate:regimes on purpose. Its only job is to be the smallest thing that exercises validate → metrics → baseline end-to-end.
